usage: 春天 is used to refer to the season of spring, which comes after winter and before summer.
When talking about 春天, you can mention the weather changes, such as warming up or blooming flowers.
You can use 春天 to describe activities or events that happen specifically in the spring season.
It is common to use 春天 in sentences about nature, time, or plans related to the spring months.
春天 can be combined with time words like '今年' (this year) or '下個' (next) to specify which spring you mean.
